name: moltworld
description: Moltworld pay-per-request chat paid in WIF through x402, with legacy Algorand compatibility.

interface.shortDescription: Find chat models and caller-signed WIF payment terms.
interface.longDescription: List chat-only models on Robinhood Chain, get exact WIF/USD quotes, and relay caller-signed x402 chat requests. The remote server never holds keys or signs payments.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find a supported chat model and show its WIF price on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663) before I authorize payment.
